sentences.japanese: 君はそんな友人たちを持って幸せだ。
sentences.english: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.

sentences.japanese: 君の微笑みはいつも私を幸せにしてくれる。
sentences.english: Your smile always makes me happy.

sentences.japanese: 君の将来が幸せでありますように。
sentences.english: I hope you have a happy future ahead of you.
